# DevStackBox
> Free XAMPP alternative for Windows - Apache, MySQL 8.4 LTS, PHP 8.3 in the installer, PHP 8.2–8.5 in the app.

## Product
- Download: https://www.devstackbox.com/download
- XAMPP alternative: https://www.devstackbox.com/xampp-alternative
- Docs: https://www.devstackbox.com/docs
- GitHub: https://github.com/DevStackBox/DevStackBox

## Stack
- Bundled: PHP 8.3, Apache 2.4, MySQL 8.4 LTS, phpMyAdmin
- In app: PHP 8.2, 8.4, 8.5 (latest supported branch: 8.5)

## v0.1.17 highlights
- Apache ignores ancestor .htaccess files by default so Laravel `public/` docroots work without parent `<IfModule not allowed here` errors
- Additive Apache migration with syntax check and timestamped backup; public rewrites still enabled for HTTP and HTTPS

## v0.1.12 highlights
- Project details: hostname, folder, document root, aliases, health checks, HTTPS controls
- Per-project website PHP (installed runtimes only; terminal still uses global PHP)
- Trusted local HTTPS with bundled mkcert; localhost and per-project certificates
- Connect existing folders outside www; safer in-place upgrades from v0.1.11
